source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check the PDB BMC heart beat LED on the board.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: The LED should be GREEN with flashing.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: checking whether "PDB BMC heart beat LED" [Wistron-HW-00106-V003] (the PDB heartbeat LED) shows the expected solid/blink GREEN color is a physical/visual LED observation (often inside the chassis), requiring a person at the machine; the agent cannot see it over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: LED color/state is a physical/visual check - a person at the machine must observe and photograph the LED color/blink/state; the agent cannot see an LED over SSH.

original_test_intent: Verify that the heartbeat LED physically located on the PDB is green and flashing in the specified operating condition.
original_method: With the power distribution board in its approved operating state, a qualified operator safely identifies the PDB heartbeat LED, observes its color and cadence, and captures visual plus unexpected-log evidence.
manual_activity: A qualified hardware operator must distinguish the PDB indicator from the main-board BMC LED and directly observe green color and flash cadence. Viewing a powered PDB may require controlled chassis access that an agent cannot perform.
required_inputs: PDB assembly/revision and annotated heartbeat LED location
Green-color and flash cadence/tolerance with observation duration
Electrical/chassis/ESD viewing procedure, qualified operator and camera method
safety_requirements: Treat the PDB as energized power-distribution hardware; do not touch it, its bus bars, connectors or cabling.
Do not open or reach into the chassis without the platform-approved electrical and ESD procedure.
Stop when viewing clearance, insulation, board identity or recovery status is uncertain.
Preserve logs and visual evidence; remote health does not substitute for the LED; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the PDB-specific map and evidence timestamps.
Collect read-only BMC/host/PDB telemetry if exposed, without treating it as visual proof.
Measure cadence from operator video and flag anomalies while leaving the verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Provide the exact PDB revision, LED map, cadence rule and powered-access procedure.
Perform the safe observation and restore chassis protections.
Review visual and system evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can establish the optical state; its physical-observation conclusion is applicable, but it understates PDB electrical risk.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use direct visual observation with a safe remote camera or qualified operator and optional read-only PDB/BMC telemetry correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PDB target, green flashing behavior and both five-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL METHOD; MINIMIZE ENERGIZED ACCESS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prefer a pre-positioned insulated camera or approved viewing port that records the annotated PDB LED continuously, synchronized to read-only controller health data.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact PDB assembly and board revision.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PDB, BMC and CPLD/controller revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform PDB service and electrical-safety documentation plus the project LED specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds PDB identity and a lower-contact evidence method without changing acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; it prevents confusing the adjacent main-board LED with the PDB LED.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: PDB map, cadence tolerance, duration and safe viewing plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A camera must not be mounted where it can contact energized components or obstruct cooling.

project_override_considerations: The project may select a safe remote camera and define cadence tolerance, but cannot replace evidence of the PDB-mounted emitter with the main-board BMC LED or management telemetry.
expected_evidence: SUT/PDB/BMC identity and annotated PDB LED location
Approved green/cadence tolerance, operating state and electrical safety plan
Timestamped photo/video showing green flashing of the correct PDB LED
PDB/BMC/host health, chassis restoration and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently identify the PDB heartbeat LED and green flashing. Omitted board mapping and cadence tolerances are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The inspection is feasible with a qualified operator and an approved safe viewing method. Manual and high-risk do not automatically mean BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO/physical, but add the PDB-specific identity and electrical boundary absent from its generic LED wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and the revision, cadence and energized-PDB controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Independently distinguishes this PDB case from the adjacent main-board LED rather than copying the same technical conclusion.

review_improvement: Adds the power-distribution target's distinct electrical risk and prevents wrong-LED evidence while retaining the exact green/flashing criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Although its acceptance wording matches the previous case, the physical target changes the method and hazard: the PDB may be energized and spatially separate, so positive board/revision identification and non-contact viewing are essential. The optical core is still manual.

no_automatic_retry: Use one approved observation interval. On unsafe access, uncertain identity or insufficient evidence, stop and retain the record; do not reopen the chassis, touch the PDB or change power state automatically.
